pages.title: Water Turbine
pages.text: In order to construct a water turbine, you simply place a rotor next to pressurised water. Ensure your rotors are connected to a generator and it will produce power from that generator.

Rotors sit in a straight line behind the generator; the generator's face points away from them. The rotor at the end of a sluice's pressurised water gets its power, multiplied by the rotor's tier (copper 1, aluminium 2, titanium 5), and the generator hands it to the machines on its other five sides.$(br2)Rotors wear as they turn and fall back to base iron when worn out. Keep clear of them while they spin.
